interactive.label: 📖 Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through the tool, pointing at each control.

interactive.label: ❓ Help
interactive.tooltip: What the tool does, what it writes, and the known limits.

interactive.label: trajectory
interactive.tooltip: The trajectory to analyse. Drop a .dcd here or press … to pick one.

interactive.label: topology
interactive.tooltip: The structure that names the atoms of the DCD; the atom pickers list its atoms.
Open the PDB that names the atoms. DCD stores coordinates only, so this is required for them.

interactive.label: stride
interactive.tooltip: Read every Nth frame of the source trajectory.

interactive.label: forster_radius
interactive.tooltip: Foerster radius of the donor-acceptor dye pair, in Angstrom.

interactive.label: tau0
interactive.tooltip: Fluorescence lifetime of the donor in the absence of FRET, in nanoseconds.

interactive.label: t_step
interactive.tooltip: Time between successive trajectory frames, in nanoseconds.

interactive.label: Dipole (κ2)
interactive.tooltip: If enabled, uses two atoms per fluorophore and computes the orientation factor kappa2 per frame; otherwise only the first atom of each dye defines the distance and the fixed isotropic kappa2 = 2/3 is used.

interactive.label: ▶ Process trajectory
interactive.tooltip: Compute the FRET observables and save them to a CSV file.
